description_en: Calls the ListBusinessAccessPoints operation to query access point information for Express Connect circuits
description_zh: 调用ListBusinessAccessPoints接口查询物理专线的接入点信息
name: ListBusinessAccessPoints

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

BusinessAccessPoints.description_en: The list of all access point information for Express Connect circuits
BusinessAccessPoints.description_zh: 物理专线所有接入点信息列表

items.description_en: The list of all access point information for Express Connect circuits
items.description_zh: 物理专线所有接入点信息列表

AccessPointId.description_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit access point

AccessPointName.description_en: The name of the Express Connect circuit access point
AccessPointName.description_zh: 物理专线接入点的名称

CloudBoxInstanceIds.description_en:
The CloudBox instance ID.

This parameter is available when the queried Express Connect circuit and access point are CloudBox Express Connect circuits and CloudBox access points
CloudBoxInstanceIds.description_zh:
云盒实例ID。

当查询的物理专线和接入点为云盒物理专线和云盒接入点时，该参数可以查询

Latitude.description_en: The latitude of the access point

Longitude.description_en: The longitude of the access point

SupportLineOperator.description_en:
The telecommunications service providers that support physical line access. Valid values:

CT: China Telecom.
CU: China Unicom.
CM: China Mobile.
CO: Other Chinese providers.
Equinix: Equinix.
Other: Other providers outside the Chinese mainland
SupportLineOperator.description_zh:
支持接入物理线路的运营商。取值：

CT：中国电信。
CU：中国联通。
CM：中国移动。
CO：中国其他。
Equinix：Equinix。
Other：境外其他

SupportPortTypes.description_en:
The port types available for purchase at the Express Connect circuit access point. Valid values:

100Base-T: 100M Ethernet port.
1000Base-T: 1 GE electrical port.
1000Base-LX: GE single-mode optical port (10 km).
10GBase-T: 10 GE electrical port.
10GBase-LR: 10 GE single-mode optical port (10 km).
40GBase-LR: 40 GE single-mode optical port.
100GBase-LR: 100 GE single-mode optical port.

40GBase-LR and 100GBase-LR ports are created based on actual backend port availability. Contact your account manager for details
SupportPortTypes.description_zh:
物理专线接入点支持购买的端口类型。取值：

100Base-T：百兆电口。
1000Base-T：千兆电口。
1000Base-LX：千兆单模光口（10千米）。
10GBase-T：万兆电口。
10GBase-LR：万兆单模光口（10千米）。
40GBase-LR：四万兆单模光口。
100GBase-LR：十万兆单模光口。

40GBase-LR和100GBase-LR需要根据实际后台端口水位情况进行创建，具体水位情况请联系商务经理
